title: Attributes
description: Reusable specification fields (materials, dimensions, care, etc.) assigned per product.

reorder.handle: Drag to reorder, or use arrow keys

bulk.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete {count} attribute(s). Attributes in use on products cannot be deleted.

rowActions.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete “{title}”. Attributes assigned to products cannot be deleted.

form.sheetDescription: Create a reusable specification field your team can assign on products.
form.sheetDescriptionEdit: Update storefront labels per locale, value type, and allowed options.

localePicker.label: Language
localePicker.filledCountHint: name and option labels in each language
localePicker.incompleteToastDescription: Fill in the name (and option labels if applicable) for: {locales}.

form.slugHint: Generated from the Polish name until you edit this field.

hints.id: Permanent identifier for this attribute. Used in the admin and APIs; it cannot be changed after creation.

titleLocale.pl-PL: Label shown in the admin and storefront (Polish). Required.
titleLocale.en-US: Label shown in the admin and storefront (English). Required.

hints.slug: Stable key for APIs and templates. Filled from the default storefront locale name until you edit it manually. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
hints.type: How values are stored and validated when assigned to a product.
hints.unit: Pick a common unit or enter a custom one. Only applies to number attributes.
hints.allowedValues: For single or multiple choice: define options with a label per storefront locale. A stable key (slug from the default-locale label) is stored in the database.

validation.LOCALE_TITLE_REQUIRED: Fill in this field for the selected language.
validation.ALLOWED_VALUES_REQUIRED: Add at least one allowed value for this type.
validation.HANDLE_INVALID: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (e.g. materials).
validation.submitBlockedDescription: Check highlighted fields and try again.

toast.createSuccessDescription: Your attribute has been created successfully.
toast.errorDescription: The attribute could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.duplicateHandle: An attribute with this URL slug already exists.
toast.reorderErrorDescription: The new attribute order could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.deleteErrorDescription: The selected attributes could not be deleted. Please try again.
toast.deleteInUseDescription: One or more attributes are assigned to products. Remove them from products before deleting.
toast.allowedValueSlugEmptyDescription: Enter a Polish label so we can generate the option key (slug).
toast.allowedValueDuplicateDescription: Another entry uses the same key — change the Polish label.

delete.title: Delete attributes
delete.description: Attributes in use on products cannot be deleted.

empty: No attributes yet. Add fields your team can reuse on products.
